description: Postal code (kode pos) of every village (desa/kelurahan) in Indonesia, keyed by the Kemendagri region code of the wilayah set: [code, postal code].
source: https://github.com/cahyadsn/wilayah_kodepos (db/wilayah_kodepos.sql, data last edited 2025-06-30, commit ba84971 of 2026-07-17), region codes per Kepmendagri No 300.2.2-2138 Tahun 2025 (same as wilayah 2026-02-13)
procedure: tools/converters/kodepos.py reads the SQL dump with a strict pattern and checks every code against data/wilayah; the result equals the upstream json/wilayah_kodepos.json.

fields.postal_code: 5-digit kode pos as text (keep leading zeros if any)

notes: One postal code per village; a postal code usually covers several villages.
Use it to suggest or check a postal code after the user picks a village; let users correct it, since Pos Indonesia can differ for single streets.
